paper.title_en: Gravitational wave emission from nonspherical collapse in an early matter-dominated era using N-body simulations
paper.abstract_en: We study the dynamics of the collapse of a nonspherical overdense patch during an early matter-dominated era and the associated production of gravitational waves (GWs) using a semirelativistic N-body framework that we develop. The collapsing patch is initialized through a Zel'dovich deformation of a homogeneous sphere and evolved in an Einstein--de Sitter background, while the emitted signal is computed directly from the numerical quadrupole evolution. We show that a reliable prediction of the signal requires a fully numerical treatment of the nonlinear collapse dynamics. In particular, fitting-based procedures and Zel'dovich-based estimates fail to capture the post-shell-crossing evolution and can over/under-estimate the emitted power of the GWs. After averaging over realizations weighted by the Doroshkevich and BBKS (peak theory) distributions, we find that the two spectra have similar shapes and remain within the same overall order of magnitude at the peak amplitude, although the BBKS result is systematically smaller. The dominant contribution arises from peaks of relatively modest height, around $ν\simeq 3$, while a larger variance significantly enhances the signal. Finally, by varying the horizon mass and reheating temperature, we map the present-day GW spectra to the sensitivity bands of different classes of detectors. In this way, the signal can populate a broad range of frequencies, from pulsar timing arrays to very high-frequency experiments, showing that GWs from nonspherical collapse can provide a probe of the pre-BBN thermal history.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在早期物质主导时代非球对称坍缩的引力波产生方面进行了半相对论N体模拟研究，直接针对脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）等探测频段；方法细节充分，结论对预BBN热历史探测有潜在意义，元数据完整且被接受发表，值得深入阅读。
decision.title_zh: 使用N体模拟研究早期物质主导时代非球对称坍缩的引力波发射
decision.abstract_zh: 我们使用我们开发的半相对论N体框架，研究了早期物质主导时代期间非球对称过密区域的坍缩动力学以及伴随的引力波（GWs）产生。坍缩区域通过均匀球体的Zel'dovich形变初始化，并在Einstein--de Sitter背景中演化，而发射的信号则直接从数值四极矩演化中计算。我们表明，对信号的可靠预测需要对非线性坍缩动力学进行完全数值处理。特别是，基于拟合的方法和基于Zel'dovich的估计无法捕捉壳层穿越后的演化，并可能高估/低估引力波的发射功率。在按照Doroshkevich和BBKS（峰值理论）分布加权的实现上进行平均后，我们发现两个谱具有相似的形状，并且在峰值振幅处保持在相同的整体数量级内，尽管BBKS结果系统性地更小。主要贡献来自高度相对适中的峰值，约为$\nu\simeq 3$，而较大的方差显著增强了信号。最后，通过改变视界质量和再加热温度，我们将今天的引力波谱映射到不同类探测器的灵敏度波段。这样，信号可以覆盖从脉冲星计时阵列到甚高频实验的广泛频率范围，表明来自非球对称坍缩的引力波可以提供一种探测pre-BBN热历史的探针。
